summary: Session 1 of 008-gallery-survey-and-feasibility complete. Defined the fixed characterization record schema (docs/research/gallery-survey/schema.md), harvested the musicnotation.org gallery (54 systems in 10 categories, enumerated in index.md and verified against the raw gallery HTML), and characterized every indexed system from detail-page text + gallery images into catalog.md — 54 records plus the supplementary out-of-gallery Dodeka record (S1). All 55 records machine-validated against the schema closed sets and cross-field rules; unknown recorded wherever sources did not support a confident value. Cross-provider verification: round 1 ISSUES_FOUND (6 issues — schema claim wording, Dodeka year literal, four over-classified duration values, record-19 name/source), all remediated in commit a8bbc5d; round 2 VERIFIED.

reason.specifics: Session 2 classifies the cataloged systems into feasibility tiers and derives the enhancement-requirements catalog; the same orchestrator already holds the survey context and the schema conventions.
